_comment: Task types. weight = how often the spawner picks it. timeLimit and hold are seconds. calm = anger removed on success; angerOnFail = anger added if the timer runs out. signin: a new kid at the sign-in table (legitChance = share of good registration cards; angerOnWrong = anger for a wrong call). drill = a training group is bored and needs Andy to run a drill. dog = a dog loose on the pitch (pooChance = chance it leaves a present when it gets away). poo = dog mess on the pitch. changing = mud, kit and puddles in the changing rooms, or a blocked loo. neighbour = a neighbour complaining at their garden gate: fobbing them off removes brushOffCalm anger, saying sorry adds ticketAnger. ball = a ball over the fence into a garden. parent = a shouty touchline parent. trouble = kids climbing the goal, kicking balls at the clubhouse, scrapping, or legging it to the ice cream van. injury = magic sponge time. net = a goal net is ripped. balls = the balls are flat. alistair = Alistair is nicking tea and biscuits from the tea hut hatch. lee = Lycra Lee is cycling across the pitch. assistant = Gaz is on his phone. phone: the office phone or Andy's mobile (whatsappChance = the parents' WhatsApp group). matt = Collector Matt trying to buy the kids' shirts off the pegs. walker = someone wandering across the pitch. burst = a ball has burst. leeds = someone bad-mouthing Leeds United (Andy takes it very personally: big anger if ignored, big calm when he puts them right). Every brushOffsBeforeManager fob-offs in a day, the Club Chairman wants a word (chairman).
